name: Grell Earring
summary: In Bashal'Aran, Grell Earring bears traces of the seal that binds Asterion.

sections.title: Traces in the Brass
sections.body: Wild Grells and Vile Sprites gather scraps among Bashal'Aran's ruins and shape them into earrings. Most mortals see only trinkets without worth. But Asterion, an ancient night elf bound there as a tormented phantom, studies the magic they retain. He hopes those traces will lead him to the ancient seal that imprisons him.

faq.q: Where do Grell Earrings come from?
faq.answer: Wild Grells and Vile Sprites carry the earrings through the ruins of Bashal'Aran, a night elven settlement in Darkshore.

faq.q: Why does Asterion want these earrings?
faq.answer: Asterion is an ancient spirit held captive in Bashal'Aran by potent magic. He seeks traces of the seal that has bound his soul for centuries.

faq.q: How do the earrings help Asterion search for the seal?
faq.answer: Asterion hopes to cast a spell over the earrings and trace the seal that imprisons his spectral form in Bashal'Aran.

faq.q: Does Asterion find what he needs from the earrings?
faq.answer: The earrings do not hold the seal itself. Their traces show that the creatures have recently been near it, guiding Asterion deeper into the ruins.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see how metal may keep traces of the ambient magic from ancient warding seals over time.
As a night elf, you see sacred ruins overrun by sprites wearing scavenged brass. The sight recalls how far the once-grand estates of ancient Kalimdor have fallen.
